sources.title: Ethereum Foundation Cuts 20% of Workforce in 'Leaner' Reorganization - Decrypt
sources.description: The non-profit is cutting 54 jobs as it reorganizes into focused "clusters," following a succession of leadership departures.

sources.title: Eight Executives Gone, 54 Jobs Cut: What's Happening at the Ethereum Foundation?
sources.description: The Ethereum Foundation has cut 20% of its workforce, amid a major restructuring and leadership changes, aiming for a leaner, more focused organisation.
